items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Rene, myself, Buddy Petit be somewhere... And different bands, you know like that.

ctx.x: What kind of jobs did y'all play in those days with those different bands?

Well lawn parties was the most. They was going big, middle of the week or any time. And like maybe they called Buddy Petit to go to Bugaloosa Friday and Saturday. They called me to go to Gurpoor, Biloxi Friday and Saturday. They called Rene to go up here in maybe Macomb City or Bad Nourish. But that's how the band made their money. Every band like Saturday and Friday to go off somewhere. Sunday they had to be back here to play these economy halls and advertising and things all like that. Now all day Sunday the…
You remember any of the different guys that was playing?
